title: Rs. 30m property frozen in Walasmulla drug-money probe
detail: Illegal Assets Investigation Division froze a residential property worth over Rs. 30 million for 7 days under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, alleged to be bought with drug-trafficking proceeds in a relative's name.
attribution: Per police Illegal Assets Investigation Division

title: Navy arrests 12 Indian fishermen between Katchatheevu and Mannar
detail: Sri Lanka Navy detained 12 Pamban (Tamil Nadu) fishermen and seized a trawler for alleged poaching in the Palk Strait; Indian fishermen's leaders said 22 more had been arrested the previous week.
place: Palk Strait, between Katchatheevu and Mannar
attribution: Arrest reported by Indian media citing fishermen's associations

title: CBSL names 24 prohibited pyramid schemes
detail: Central Bank declared 24 companies and apps (incl. Qnet/Questnet, Sport Chain, MTFE App) prohibited schemes under Section 83C of the Banking Act.
attribution: Determination by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka

title: Navy intercepts trawlers with 600+ kg heroin/ice and firearms
detail: Navy intercepted a multi-day fishing trawler in the southern seas carrying over 600 kg of heroin and crystal meth plus T-56 and M-16 rifles and pistols; a second vessel that came to assist was also seized, 10 suspects arrested, vessels taken to Dikkowita.
attribution: Per Sri Lanka Navy, via Newsfirst; described as the largest haul of 2026 at that time

title: Health Promotion Bureau warns of leptospirosis
detail: Health Promotion Bureau said about 13,000 leptospirosis cases and nearly 300 deaths were recorded within a year.
attribution: Figures per Health Promotion Bureau

title: 135 held in Chinese-run scam operation in Anuradhapura
detail: Immigration authorities raided an alleged Chinese-run online scam site, arresting 135 people incl. 126 Chinese nationals, mostly for tourist-visa violations; computers and phones seized. Officials called it the biggest such raid since Oct 2024.
attribution: Per Sri Lankan immigration officials via AFP

title: Heat index 'Caution level' alert for 14 districts
detail: Department of Meteorology said the heat index could reach 'Caution level' on 26 March in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern and North-western provinces and Anuradhapura, Mannar, Vavuniya and Monaragala districts.
place: Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern, North-western provinces + 4 districts
attribution: Advisory issued by the Department of Meteorology, via Newswire

title: Seven Rameswaram fishermen arrested near Neduntheevu
detail: Navy arrested 7 Rameswaram fishermen and seized two mechanised trawlers near Neduntheevu (Delft) islet, prompting protests in Thangachimadam, Tamil Nadu.
attribution: Reported by Indian media

title: 152 foreigners arrested at Chilaw hotel scam hub
detail: Police and immigration raided a rented hotel in Chilaw, arresting 152 foreigners (133 Chinese, 13 Vietnamese, 6 others) and seizing 143 laptops, 120 desktops and 370 phones; two men were hurt trying to flee.
attribution: Per Sri Lanka Police via AFP

title: 12 Indian fishermen held off Jaffna
detail: Navy arrested 12 Tamil Nadu fishermen and seized a trawler near Jaffna for alleged poaching; report said over 100 Indian fishermen had been detained so far in 2026.
attribution: Year-to-date figure per Deccan Herald

title: Nine Chinese arrivals from Kunming stopped with hundreds of devices
detail: Customs intercepted nine Chinese nationals arriving from Kunming carrying hundreds of electronic devices suspected for scam operations.
attribution: Per East Asia Forum analysis

title: Over 25,000 dengue cases so far in 2026
detail: National Dengue Control Unit reported 25,082 cases and 12 deaths in 2026, highest in Colombo, Gampaha, Matara, Galle, Ratnapura and Kalutara.
attribution: Per NDCU consultant Dr Prashila Samaraweera

title: 261 Chinese and Vietnamese held in Colombo scam raids
detail: Police arrested 157 on 5 May, 74 Vietnamese in Kollupitiya on 6 May and 30 Chinese/Vietnamese in Werahera on 7 May; spokesman F.U. Wootler said suspects entered on tourist visas and worked illegally.
attribution: Per police spokesman F.U. Wootler

title: 198 Indians and Nepalis arrested in southern coast raids
detail: Police raids at a Midigama hotel, Hikkaduwa guesthouse and two Galle lodgings arrested 173 Indians and 25 Nepalis plus a lodge owner over online financial fraud; computers, phones and Rs. 750,000 cash seized; CID investigating.
attribution: Per Sri Lanka Police

title: 14 Chinese and Malaysians arrested at Waskaduwa hotel
detail: Police arrested 12 Chinese and 2 Malaysian nationals without valid visas at a Waskaduwa hotel; Sunday Times said over 500 foreigners had been held for cybercrime in the first five months.
attribution: Per police via The Sunday Times

title: Train derails between Wanawasala and Hunupitiya, 12 hurt
detail: A carriage overturned when a train derailed between Wanawasala and Hunupitiya, injuring 12 passengers, police spokesman F.U. Wootler said.
attribution: Per police spokesman F.U. Wootler

title: Police: over 1,000 foreign scam suspects arrested in 2026
detail: ABC reported police saying more than 1,000 foreign suspects had been arrested in 2026 versus 430 in 2024, amid concern scam networks are relocating from Southeast Asia.
attribution: Figures per Sri Lanka Police via ABC

title: Island-wide power outage
detail: An island-wide power failure hit multiple regions; the cause had not been officially explained at time of reporting and CEB was working on restoration.
attribution: Single aggregator report; not independently confirmed

title: CBSL public notice lists 25 prohibited pyramid schemes
detail: Central Bank notice listed 25 entities, adding Infinity Rover (Pvt) Ltd, as prohibited schemes under Section 83C of the Banking Act No. 30 of 1988.
attribution: CBSL official notice

title: Dengue passes 63,000 cases; Colombo and Gampaha lead
detail: NDCU daily update: 63,835 cases and 42 deaths in 2026 to 7 July; Colombo 12,968 and Gampaha 12,929 cases; Western Province 52.6% of cases.
attribution: NDCU official daily update

title: Five killed in Homagama helmet factory fire
detail: Fire at a helmet factory in the Katuwana/Homagama industrial zone killed five workers; about 10 fire engines were deployed.
attribution: Per Daily Mirror via Report.az

title: Nine Indian fishermen arrested north of Talaimannar
detail: Navy arrested 9 Indian fishermen and seized a trawler north of Talaimannar after alleged IMBL crossing.
attribution: Reported by Deccan Herald

title: Major flood warning for Kelani River basin
detail: Irrigation Department warned a major flood could develop within 24 hours in low-lying areas of Dehiowita, Ruwanwella and Yatiyantota DS divisions, with minor flood risk further downstream (Seethawaka to Kolonnawa).
attribution: Warning issued by the Irrigation Department, via Newsfirst

title: Landslides and floods kill 7 in central highlands
detail: Disaster Management Centre said 5 people died when a landslide buried houses and 2 in floods; nearly 3,500 people evacuated and 129 houses damaged in Nuwara Eliya and Badulla districts. Schools in the central highlands were shut; area still recovering from Cyclone Ditwah (Nov 2025).
attribution: Figures per Disaster Management Centre spokesperson Pradeep Kodippili, via Al Jazeera

title: Red advisories for wind and rough seas as rains kill at least 6
detail: Reports citing police said at least 6 died and 1 was missing after heavy rain; red-level landslide evacuation warnings and red advisories for strong winds and rough seas were in force, with schools shut in Kandy and Nuwara Eliya.
place: Sabaragamuwa, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya; coastal seas
attribution: Casualty figures per police via Ada Derana; advisories from Sri Lankan weather/disaster agencies

title: Navy rescue op for grounded Indian trawler off Delft
detail: An Indian trawler with 11 crew ran aground on a reef off Delft Island; Navy spokesman Cdr Chaminda Walakuluge said it had been fishing illegally in Sri Lankan waters and the crew were not in immediate danger.
attribution: Per Sri Lanka Navy spokesman

title: 1,093 foreigners arrested in 27 anti-cybercrime operations
detail: Police spokesman F.U. Wootler said 1,093 foreign nationals were arrested in 27 operations in 2026 (vs 573 in 2024); landlords told to register foreign tenants.
attribution: Per police spokesman F.U. Wootler

title: 471 kg of 'Ice' found in uncleared Colombo Port container
detail: Police Narcotics Bureau with Pakistan's ANF and US DEA found 471 kg of crystal meth (est. Rs. 7 billion) in a container from Pakistan declared as towels, meant for re-export to Cameroon; 3 Pakistanis and 4 Sri Lankans detained.
attribution: Figures per police/authorities via The Sunday Times

title: 34 shootings, 17 deaths in 2026 amid gang violence
detail: Daily Mirror reported 34 shooting incidents in 2026 so far, leaving 17 dead and 18 injured, amid suspected underworld activity.
attribution: Figures as reported by Daily Mirror (official source not named in excerpt)

title: Grenade attack on Dehiwala house kills two children
detail: A grenade thrown at a house on Sirisangabo Mawatha killed two children (11 and 17) and badly injured their father; police said the attacker hit the wrong house while targeting a drug trafficker. Suspects were later arrested.
attribution: Per police, via The Sunday Times

title: Three-wheeler driver shot dead near Dematagoda bridge
detail: A 50-year-old three-wheeler driver (ex-Army) was shot dead execution-style by a gunman riding as passenger, amid a surge in underworld shootings.
attribution: Per police, via The Sunday Times

title: NBRO Level 3 (Red) landslide warnings for hill districts
detail: National Building Research Organisation issued its highest (Level 3 Red) landslide warnings for parts of Kandy, Kegalle and Nuwara Eliya districts, urging residents to be ready to evacuate.
place: Kandy, Kegalle and Nuwara Eliya districts
attribution: Warning issued by NBRO, as reported by Lanka Newspapers (aggregator)

title: Couple arrested, Rs. 47.5m assets frozen in laundering probe
detail: A couple in Padavi Parakramapura were arrested and Rs. 47.5 million in assets placed under a 14-day freezing order in a money-laundering investigation.
attribution: Reported by Daily Mirror

title: Dengue cases reach about 82,800 in 2026
detail: Daily Mirror tracker reported 82,838 dengue cases and 63 deaths in 2026, with Gampaha highest (17,600).
attribution: Daily Mirror live tracker (based on dengue surveillance data)
